description: Design a UART controller that transmits data serially. The UART controller should accept an 8-bit data input and a control signal to start the transmission. It will output the transmitted data bit by bit at a specified baud rate. The output will include a start bit (0), the 8 data bits, and a stop bit (1) at the end. The transmission will occur on a clock edge.
code:
module uart_transmitter (
    input wire clk,               // Clock input
    input wire reset,             // Reset input
    input wire start_tx,          // Start transmission signal
    input wire [7:0] data_in,     // 8-bit data input
    output reg tx,                // Transmit output
    output reg busy               // Transmission status
);

    reg [3:0] bit_index;          // Index to track which bit to send
    reg [10:0] shift_reg;         // Shift register to hold the frame (start + data + stop)
    reg [15:0] baud_counter;      // Counter for baud rate

    localparam BAUD_DIV = 16'd104; // Example baud rate division factor for 9600bps
    
    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            tx <= 1'b1;            // Idle state is high
            busy <= 1'b0;
            bit_index <= 4'd0;
            baud_counter <= 16'd0;
            shift_reg <= 11'b0;
        end else begin
            if (start_tx && !busy) begin
                // Load the shift register with the start bit, data, and stop bit
                shift_reg <= {1'b1, data_in, 1'b0}; // Stop bit, data, start bit
                busy <= 1'b1;                     // Set busy flag
                bit_index <= 4'd0;                // Start with the first bit
                baud_counter <= 16'd0;             // Reset baud counter
            end else if (busy) begin
                if (baud_counter < BAUD_DIV) begin
                    baud_counter <= baud_counter + 1; // Wait for the baud rate clock
                end else begin
                    baud_counter <= 16'd0; // Reset baud counter
                    if (bit_index < 11) begin
                        tx <= shift_reg[0]; // Send the least significant bit
                        shift_reg <= shift_reg >> 1; // Shift right
                        bit_index <= bit_index + 1; // Move to the next bit
                    end else begin
                        busy <= 1'b0;        // Transmission complete
                        tx <= 1'b1;          // Set idle state
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
endmodule

    end
end

    input wire rst,
    input wire [3:0] dividend,
    input wire [3:0] divisor,
    output reg [3:0] quotient,
    output reg [3:0] remainder,
    output reg done
);
    reg [3:0] A; // Register for the dividend
    reg [3:0] Q; // Register for the quotient
    reg [3:0] M; // Register for the divisor
    reg [2:0] count; // Counter for the number of bits processed
    reg state; // State flag (0: processing, 1: done)
    
    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            A <= 4'b0000;
            Q <= 4'b0000;
            M <= 4'b0000;
            count <= 3'b000;
            done <= 0;
            state <= 0;
        end else begin
            if (state == 0) begin // Processing state
                if (count < 4) begin
                    A <= {A[2:0], dividend[3 - count]}; // Shift A with dividend bit
                    Q <= {Q[2:0], 1'b0}; // Shift Q left
                    if (A >= M) begin
                        A <= A - M; // Subtract M from A
                        Q[0] <= 1'b1; // Set LSB of Q to 1
                    end
                    count <= count + 1;
                end else begin
                    remainder <= A; // Set remainder
                    quotient <= Q; // Set quotient
                    done <= 1; // Signal done
                    state <= 1; // Move to done state
                end
            end
        end
    end

            M <= divisor; // Load divisor
        end
    end

    input wire start,         // Start signal to initiate SPI communication  
    input wire mosi_data,     // Data to send to the slave

    output reg sclk,           // SPI clock  
    output reg cs,             // Chip select for the slave  
    output reg [7:0] data_out, // Data to be sent  
    input wire [7:0] data_in   // Data received from the slave  
);

    reg [7:0] shift_reg;  
    reg sending;

        if (start) begin  
            cs <= 0;                // Enable chip select  
            bit_count <= 0;         // Reset bit count  
            shift_reg <= mosi_data; // Load data to send  
            sending <= 1;           // Start sending data  
        end  
        else if (sending) begin  
            sclk <= ~sclk;          // Toggle clock  
            if (sclk) begin          // On the rising edge of SCLK  
                miso_data <= shift_reg[7]; // Send most significant bit  
                data_out <= {data_out[6:0], 1'b0}; // Shift out data  
                shift_reg <= {shift_reg[6:0], 1'b0}; // Shift the data register  
                bit_count <= bit_count + 1;  
            end  
            if (bit_count == 7) begin  // Last bit sent  
                cs <= 1;                // Disable chip select  
                sending <= 0;           // Stop sending  
                miso_data <= data_in;   // Read the received data  
            end  
        end  
        else begin  
            sclk <= 0;                // Ensure clock is low when not sending  
        end  
    end  
endmodule
